style.name: 晨雾便签
style.css: #root{--ink:#313a43;--muted:#6b7881;--accent:#bf694e;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:8px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #ffffffa8;background:#f3f0e8dc;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);color:var(--ink);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff35,0 12px 28px #0002}#root:before{content:'';pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ffffff15,transparent 58%)}header,footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;flex:none;gap:5px;font-size:8px;color:var(--muted)}header .mark{color:var(--accent);font-size:14px;line-height:1}header span:nth-child(2){margin-right:auto;font-weight:650}header .count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;position:relative;flex:none}.stat{min-width:0;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 3px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 25%,transparent);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px}.stat b{font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent)}.stat span{font-size:6px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.stat.today{--accent:#ff9470}.stat.completed{--accent:#f05f86}.stat.total{--accent:#9d8dff}.task-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;position:relative;margin-top:2px}.task-head i{height:14px;width:3px;background:var(--accent);display:block}.task-head strong{font-size:9px}.task-list{min-height:0;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto}.task{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;min-width:0;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4}.check{border:1px solid var(--accent);height:11px;width:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;border-radius:50%;color:var(--accent);font-size:9px;line-height:1}.task.done{opacity:.55}.task.done .task-text{text-decoration:line-through}.task-text{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}footer{border-top:1px solid #ffffffa8;padding-top:6px;margin-top:auto;font-size:8px}.footer-mark{color:var(--accent)}.stats{gap:2px}.stat{padding:3px 1px}.stat span{font-size:5px}.task-head{display:none}.task-list{display:none}footer{border-top:0;padding-top:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.mark{animation:glow 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes glow{to{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(35deg)}}}
